gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-imperial-ara: Revalia swaggers in with a loose, unhurried stride, its letters spaced far apart and a lowercase g that leaves its lower curve open. Noto Sans Imperial Aramaic is the more practical one, with c-shapes whose ends point apart and capitals only a short step above the lowercase.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-jp: Widely spaced letters give Revalia a relaxed, expressive stride, bold without ever hurrying. And Noto Sans JP settles in beneath with a very high x-height and curves that sweep open, so extended text goes down smoothly.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-kaithi: Loud, loose and a little theatrical. Revalia is the showy half, while Noto Sans Kaithi has lowercase forms so large they almost read as capitals, and that size contrast is the pair's most striking quality.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-kayah-li: Revalia strides across the line with widely separated letters and a lowercase g left open at the bottom. Noto Sans Kayah Li reads smoothly, its capitals barely rising above the lowercase.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-kharoshthi: Revalia's relaxed stride, with its letters set far apart, is the first thing you notice, along with that open-bottomed g. Noto Sans Kharoshthi runs dark and dense, its curves never closing, so a long read feels weighty.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-khmer: Bold, loose and full of swagger, with Revalia's spaced-out letters stretching along the line. Noto Sans Khmer stands up proud beside it, its small letters nearly capital-sized, and the two feel like a shout next to a firm handshake.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-khojki: Loose-limbed and expressive, Revalia spreads its letters wide. Noto Sans Khojki sits alongside with large, clear e eyes and wide exits, so the showy heading gets a body that lets light through.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-kr: Revalia is bold, with spacious letters and an open-curved g. Noto Sans KR works beside it with stubby ascenders and descenders around a big x-height, and its generous curve gaps give the heading's flair somewhere calm to land.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-lao: Revalia's relaxed stride across widely separated letters is its signature, bold and expressive in equal measure. Noto Sans Lao follows with an x-height pushed well above the usual and mouths that stay open, so a long page reads easily.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-lao-looped: Expressive from the first letter, Revalia strides along with wide gaps between its bold forms. Noto Sans Lao Looped forms words as solid blocks, with bowls left unfinished on one side, so extended reading feels compact and steady.
